مرور راهبردهای پیش‌سدیم‌گذاری فیزیکی، شیمیایی، الکتروشیمیایی و افزودنی فداشونده برای آند کربن سخت باتری‌های یون‌سدیم با تمرکز بر تنظیم و تکامل SEI و بهبود ICE.
Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely examines presodiation strategies through the lens of SEI formation and evolution in hard carbon anodes, linking interphase timing, composition, morphology, and spatial distribution to electrochemical performance. By connecting interfacial features with ICE, resistance, rate capability, and cycling stability, it identifies how presodiation conditions govern SEI development, offering guidance for practical sodium-ion battery design.
🏷 sodium-ion batteries · hard carbon anode · presodiation · solid electrolyte interphase · initial coulombic efficiency

item.title: Plasma‐Assisted Amine‐Functionalized BNNT Stabilizing the Ni–CoTe@Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene Electrode for Flexible Supercapacitor
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in Ar/NH₃ plasma-functionalized BNNTs stabilizing Ni–CoTe heterostructures on MXene, preventing aggregation and restacking. This multidimensional design enables synergistic Faradaic and surface-controlled storage, yielding 44 Wh/kg, 5400 W/kg, and ~91% retention over 30,000 cycles. It significantly advances durable, high-performance flexible supercapacitors.

item.title: Reprogramming Interfacial Hydrogen-Bond Networks via Asymmetric Single-Atom Catalysts
item.description:

ACS Catalysis | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Asymmetric Co-N3O1 single-atom sites, formed via rapid Joule heating, break local symmetry to reprogram interfacial hydrogen-bond networks, weakening over-connected water networks and boosting proton transfer. This yields superior four-electron oxygen reduction (0.866 V half-wave) and high-performance zinc-air batteries, establishing asymmetric single-atom modulation as a new paradigm for catalyst-water interface engineering.

item.title: Oxygen Partial Pressure as a Kinetic Descriptor for Single‐Crystal Morphology in Mid‐Nickel Layered Cathodes
item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work establishes oxygen partial pressure as a quantitative kinetic descriptor governing densification versus grain-growth competition in mid-nickel layered cathodes. By coupling calcination experiments with phase-field modeling, it proposes an air–oxygen sequential process that overcomes single-atmosphere trade-offs, enabling time-efficient single-crystal formation with improved cycling stability (83.04% retention versus ~77%). This offers a scalable, predictive route for durable single-crystal cathode synthesis.
🏷 single-crystal cathode · oxygen partial pressure · grain growth · calcination · lithium-ion battery

item.title: Exploring Li growth modes in Li metal electrodes using X-ray nano-tomography
item.description:
با نانوتوموگرافی اشعه ایکس درجا، حالت‌های رشد سوزنی و ورقه‌ای لیتیوم و ارتباط آن با SEI و دانه‌های جدید نشان داده شد.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work achieves time-resolved 3D imaging of lithium metal growth inside working cells using in situ X-ray nano-tomography at sub-micron resolution. It identifies distinct needle-like and sheet-like growth modes, with elongation at tips, bases, kinks, or edges and minimal coarsening. Linking these modes to grain nucleation and SEI evolution provides unprecedented mechanistic insight into Li deposition, advancing high-energy Li-metal battery development.

item.title: Role‐Differentiated Solvation Directs Interfacial Chemistry in Wide‐Temperature Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work decouples solvation from reactivity by assigning distinct molecular roles in a quaternary ester–ether electrolyte, excluding methyl propionate from Li+ coordination while an ether–anion network builds a PDOL–LiF heteromatrix interphase. This enables dense Li deposition and wide-temperature operation (−30 to 70°C), offering a general design principle to resolve the transport–stability trade-off in all-climate lithium metal batteries.

💡 This work introduces latent solvation chemistry, where a weakly coordinating diluent is recruited into the Li+ solvation shell upon cooling, dynamically adapting the electrolyte. This enables 5 C fast charging at −20°C, stable cycling at −50°C, and long pouch-cell life, offering a molecular design strategy for wide-temperature fast-charging lithium-ion batteries.

item.description:

💡 High-pressure lamination is shown to be decisive for Sn buffer layers in low-pressure all-solid-state Li batteries. Decoupling lamination from stack pressure reveals that good Sn–solid electrolyte contact enables Li⁺ transport and deposition beneath the buffer, improving Li utilization, lowering overpotential, and suppressing voids and short circuits at 1 MPa.

💡 This study uniquely links solvent impurity origins to battery performance during electrolyte scale-up, classifying impurities by synthesis pathway. It reveals a critical removal–generation trade-off in purification and identifies water, alkoxides, and amines as key degraders.
